subject.title: Gateway: account-scoped channel config changes restart the entire channel and can disrupt active traffic

question: Should OpenClaw treat `channels.<kind>.accounts.<accountId>` reloads as generic account-scoped restarts for all channel plugins, or require an explicit plugin capability/opt-in first?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the preferred contract affects every channel plugin with account maps and is a compatibility-sensitive gateway behavior choice.

options.title: Accept generic account-scoped reloads
options.body: Land the current-base candidate with safe whole-channel fallbacks for default, global, mixed, secrets, and unlisted-account cases.

options.title: Require plugin opt-in first
options.body: Ask the candidate PR to add an explicit plugin capability before changing reload behavior for all channel plugins.

options.title: Defer generic reload granularity
options.body: Keep whole-channel restarts as the default and solve only plugin-specific restart pain until a broader contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept generic account-scoped reloads
recommendation.body: Land the current-base candidate with safe whole-channel fallbacks for default, global, mixed, secrets, and unlisted-account cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership of the gateway reload and channel lifecycle surfaces that define this compatibility contract.
